messages:
leah_sales: RFP from Meridian Bank came in — they want a single-package RFI: capability matrix, filled security questionnaire, and a short POC plan. Deadline Wed COB. Main asks: strict data residency (us-east-1), ability to redact PII at ingest, KMS BYOK with HSM option, and example throughput SLOs for peak trading windows. Questionnaire link: https://drive.google.com/meridian/rfp-q.docx

omar_se: Copy. I'll build a capability matrix that highlights redaction options (client-side vs server-side), support for on-prem/private, and passthrough KMS. Quick Q: do we currently offer automatic PII redaction pipelines or only sample tooling?

rachel_privsec: We have a data protection module in Private deployments that supports deterministic token redaction and regex/ML-based PII filters. For Hosted and Dedicated we offer configurable pre-processing hooks; for strict banking regs we recommend Private (on-prem or VPC-hosted) so keys and redaction run inside customer boundaries.

ben_finance: Pricing note — PII redaction as a managed service is add-on (hourly batch jobs + per-token processing). For the matrix, show pricing as: Base inference rate + Redaction per-token rate + Optional KMS integration fee. I'll produce three example bundles.

omar_se: Draft POC plan: 10 business days. Day 0 NDA and network contacts. Day 1 environment prep (Private if possible), Day 3 ingest + redaction integration, Day 5 perf run during synthetic peak load, Day 8 security review + audit log review, Day 10 wrap + recommendation doc. Need their network contact and sample schema.

leah_sales: I'll ask Meridian to provide sample schemas and the security contact by EOD. Also confirm they will allow a test VPC peering.

rachel_privsec: For the security questionnaire items: I'll answer access controls, audit logs, key management, and data isolation. Note: we can provide FIPS 140-2 attestation for cloud HSM used in customer-managed key flows where provider offers it; for full tenant-dedicated HSM we require Private on-prem deployment. I'll attach a short appendix clarifying assumptions.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: New file uploaded: /shared/sales/meridian/rfi/meridian_capmatrix_v1.csv (owner: omar_se)

omar_se: Matrix columns I'm using: feature, hosted, dedicated, private, notes, recommended for banking. Rows include: data residency, BYOK KMS, HSM attestation, PII redaction (server-side), PII redaction (client-side), KV cache persistence, model version pinning, SLA (p99 latency, sustained throughput), network peering, SOC2/FedRAMP status, audit log retention.

ben_finance: For the SLO examples, propose: Starter: p95 < 300ms for short completions, Business: p95 < 200ms with 30-day retention and 99.9% uptime, Enterprise: p95 < 150ms, p99 < 750ms, custom retention and on-call escalation. We can attach a sample SLA doc.

omar_se: I'm adding a technical caveat: latency depends heavily on sequence length and model selection; include our recommended models for low-latency vs high-quality. Also propose automatic KV cache for repeated prefixes to hit tighter SLOs.

leah_sales: Good. Can we provide one example of past banking POC (an anonymized case study) to show turnaround?

rachel_privsec: Yes — I'll redact customer identifiers and create a one-page summary: 3-week POC, Private deploy, BYOK with cloud HSM integration, achieved p95=180ms under target load. Will upload.

leah_sales: Timeline: aim to send full package Mon lunchtime so Meridian can review before Wed COB. Please flag anything that needs Legal signoff (FIPS claims, customer-case redaction).

omar_se: Will push capmatrix_v2 with redaction rows and sample POC timeline.

ben_finance: I'll attach three pricing bundles and estimates for the add-on managed redaction service.

rachel_privsec: Escalating FIPS/HSM attestation question to Legal now.

leah_sales: Thanks team. Tag me in updates. If we get their network contact sooner I can lock the kickoff.
